blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Today's multimodal assistants are typically prompted to interpret the visual evidence presented to them. To offload the cognitive burden of remembering across long horizons, wearable assistants should instead proactively acquire and maintain useful memory as the user's surroundings evolve. Doing so on the user's behalf requires identifying what matters, understanding the scene in real time, and initiating memory maintenance in the background while the user stays focused on their activities. We introduce ProactEgoMem, a benchmark that evaluates proactive memory in streaming egocentric video. Three tasks ground the evaluation in ambient environmental needs: Information Capture (IC) preserves transient yet dense visual information, State Tracking (ST) follows changing object states, and Location Tracking (LT) records object movements. The benchmark defines its protocol at two levels of proactiveness: the Notification Level asks for a single timely notification that satisfies the user's intent, while the deeper Intervention Level asks the agent to maintain memory on the user's behalf through an active start-to-stop tool lifecycle. Parallel ProactEgoMem-Daily and ProactEgoMem-Sci tracks contain 300/100 clips covering daily and scientific use cases, paired with 1000/500 questions in ProactEgoMem-QA, which measures the quality of the proactively acquired memory. Across proprietary, open-source, video-language, and streaming baselines, even the strongest models fail to capture memory both timely and accurately. ProactEgoMem provides a rigorous evaluation foundation for proactive multimodal assistance and for video agents that co-exist with their users.
blocks.zh: 今天的多模式助理通常是为了解释提交给他们的视觉证据。 要卸下跨越长地平线记忆的认知负担,可穿戴的助手应主动获取并随着用户周围环境的发展而保持有用的内存. 代表用户这样做,需要确定什么是紧要的,实时了解场景,并在用户继续专注于活动的同时在背景中启动内存维护. 我们引入了ProactEgoMem,这个基准在流出以自我为中心的视频中评价主动记忆. 三项任务使评价以环境需要为基础:信息捕获(IC)保存瞬时而密集的视觉信息;国家跟踪(ST)跟踪不断变化的物体状态;地点跟踪(LT)记录物体运动。 该基准在主动性两个层面定义了其协议:通知级别要求一个满足用户意图的单一及时通知,而更深层的干预级别则要求代理通过一个主动起止工具生命周期来代表用户维护内存. ProactEgoMem-Daily和ProactEgoMem-Sci的音轨包含300/100个剪辑,涵盖日常和科学使用案例,与ProactEgoMem-QA的1000/500个问题对齐,该内容测量了主动获取的内存的质量. 纵观专有,开源,视频语言和流线基线,即使是最强的模型也无法及时准确地捕捉到内存. 行为 EgoMem为积极主动的多模式援助和与用户共存的视频代理提供了严格的评价基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A wearable assistant on AI glasses can reduce the burden of remembering everyday details while the user attends to other activities ( Engel et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) : for example, alert when a faucet remains running unattended while cooking, remembering where a tool is placed during multitasking
(Figure 1 ). Such assistance requires continuous background observation, where the assistant infers the user’s intent and detects relevant events, maintains ambient environment states, and alerts or remembers proactively for later use without explicit instructions. Useful information may be transient, and the dynamically complex ambient evidence may be intertwined continuously. This motivates our central question: How can a wearable assistant proactively maintain memory in the background as the user’s surroundings change over long time horizons?

AI眼镜上的可穿戴助手可以减轻用户参加其他活动时回忆日常细节的负担(Engel等人,2023年;Yang等人,2025年):例如,当水龙头在烹饪时仍然无人看管时,提醒注意,记住工具在多重任务时放置的地方.
(图1). 这种援助需要持续的背景观察,助理推断用户的意图并发现相关的事件,保持环境状态,并在没有明确指示的情况下主动提醒或提醒以后使用。 有用的信息可能是短暂的,动态复杂的环境证据可能不断交织在一起。 这引发了我们的中心问题: 可穿戴的助手如何在背景中主动保持内存,因为用户的周围环境会随着长时间的变化而变化?

blocks.en: Remembering on the user’s behalf requires more than recognizing relevant information in a video. An assistant must infer intents, capture transient details before they disappear, and keep track of changing states and object locations as activities unfold. Such memory needs extend over time: the assistant must determine when to begin acquisition, maintain tracking through subsequent observations, and stop when the relevant event ends, all while the user attends to other activities. This calls for two levels of proactive assistance: notifying the user when relevant information warrants attention, and intervening on the user’s behalf to acquire it as memory.
blocks.zh: 代表用户的记忆不仅需要视频中识别相关信息。 一个助手必须推断意图,在消失之前捕捉瞬间细节,并随着活动的展开,跟踪变化的状态和对象位置. 这种内存需要随着时间推移而来:助理必须确定何时开始获取,通过后续的观察来保持跟踪,并在相关事件结束时停止,所有这一切都是在用户参与其他活动的时候. 这就需要两级积极的协助:在相关信息需要注意时通知用户,并代表用户进行干预,以获取信息作为内存。

blocks.en: We formulate this capability as proactive memory : autonomously acquiring and maintaining useful evidence from an unfolding egocentric stream. Conventional video QA evaluates answers from post-hoc complete videos ( Mangalam et al., 2023 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) , while streaming QA evaluates responses as video arrives ( Lin et al., 2024b ) . ProactEgoMem evaluates how useful memory is acquired in the first place, how an assistant initiates and maintains background processing and intervenes proactively, and whether the resulting memory supports subsequent assistance.
blocks.zh: 我们将这种能力发展为主动的记忆:自主地从一个以自我为中心的流中获取和保持有用的证据。 常规视频QA评价来自后浩克完整视频的答案(Mangalam等人,2023年;Fu等人,2025年),而流媒体QA评价在视频到达时的答案(Lin等人,2024年b). 行为 EgoMem评价最初如何获取有用的内存,助理如何启动和维护背景处理并主动干预,以及由此产生的内存是否支持后续协助.

blocks.en:
We introduce ProactEgoMem (Figure 2 ), a benchmark for proactive memory over
streaming egocentric video, built around three object-centric tasks for ambient memories from first-person recordings: Information Capture ( IC ), State Tracking ( ST ),
and Location Tracking ( LT ). We further propose to evaluate two levels of easy-to-hard proactiveness: the Notification Level asks for a single timely, semantically
correct notification once the observation satisfies the user’s intent; the
advanced Intervention Level requires the agent to track the situation in the background and operate memory tools on the user’s behalf, such as maintaining lifecycles for recording or status and location tracking. The benchmark comprises two parallel tracks: ProactEgoMem-Daily , built from everyday
first-person recordings, with 300 clips and 1000 questions, and ProactEgoMem-Sci , built from egocentric recordings in wet-labs as co-scientist assistants, with
100 clips and 500 questions.

blocks.en: 3.2 Two Proactive Modes
blocks.zh: 3.2 两个主动模式

blocks.en: Figure 3: Two- level proactive modes .
blocks.zh: 图3:两级主动模式

blocks.en:
Offloading mental burden can be multi-faceted. Inspired by the distinction between proactively informing a user and acting
autonomously on their behalf ( Kraus et al., 2021 ) , we operationalize
proactivity at two depths (Figure 3 ; Table 1 ): Notification Level. The agent should infer the user’s intent and send a timely notification in
response to a visual cue. For example, after inferring that the user is shopping for items, the agent sends the proactive assistant message “I noticed a lot of nutrition information” when the user shows interest in an item. The
ground truth is a timestamped opportunity and a semantic target message.

blocks.en:
Common metrics. Predictions are matched and scored separately at the two proactive levels.
Predictions at both levels are matched to ground truth by Hungarian
matching ( Kuhn, 1955 ) , which requires that an LLM-judge’s semantic
similarity exceeds a threshold and that the temporal offset falls within the
matching window; among admitted edges the assignment minimizes the cost α ⁡ ( 1 − sim ) + ( 1 − α ) ​ ( | Δ | / W ) p \alpha(1-\mathrm{sim})+(1-\alpha)\,(|\Delta|/W)^{p} ( Zhang et al., 2025c ) . Intervention
predictions are first converted into intervals and matched on temporal
overlap. Three metric groups are then shared by the two levels:
(1) Timing (Start@ τ \tau ): the fraction of matched actions whose
start falls within various τ \tau seconds of the ground-truth moment. We
report Start@0.2 as the main result: the 200 ms tolerance reflects the
residual inter-annotator disagreement on notification timing
(Table 3 ) and is widely used in real-time streaming
models.
(2) Abs Error ( | Δ s | |\Delta_{s}| , σ \sigma ): the mean absolute start
offset and its standard deviation, in seconds, measuring how far and how
consistently a model deviates from the annotated moment.
(3) Detection (Prec, Recall, F1): precision over emitted actions,
recall over ground-truth events, and their harmonic mean F1,
penalizing spurious interruptions and missed ones.

blocks.en: 5.4 Effects of Proactive Memory Acquisition

blocks.en:
The headroom is in proactive memory acquisition. Timing and
lifecycle metrics score when an agent acts to acquire memory; ProactEgoMem-QA asks what that action leaves behind. A proactive assistant is useful only if the evidence it chooses to keep can answer the user’s questions later, so we test the acquired memory directly. Every question is answered
after the stream ends under three memory conditions
(Figure 6 ): uniform frames ( No Memory ), the frames the agent kept throughout its tool calls ( Proact Memory ), and the ground-truth event windows ( Oracle Memory ). Proact Memory beats No Memory on IC for every model with valid output and splits evenly on ST and LT . In 34 34 of the 36 36 valid model–task cells the oracle memory sits at least 20 20 accuracy
points above the proactive one; with oracle memory ceiling at IC 94.9 % 94.9\% while ST and LT stay below 70 % 70\% . Even with oracle memory
fed to the video QA model, the benchmark remains hard to solve, and the gap
between No Memory and Oracle Memory defines the improvable headroom for proactive memory.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
ProactEgoMem evaluates proactive ambient memory in streaming egocentric video through
two proactive modes and three task families, IC , ST and LT , across daily-life and laboratory co-scientist tracks. The
experiments show that today’s multimodal models remain far from reliable
proactive assistants: they identify the right moment only under loose timing
windows, and they struggle with precision, event tracking over long-horizon
location, and proactive memory acquisition. It charts a concrete path toward
wearable agents that remember useful context without being asked.

blocks.en: Appendix B Data Leakage Mitigation and Annotation Novelty
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据泄漏减缓和注释

blocks.en: Although raw video streams in ProactEgoMem are sampled from public egocentric repositories (e.g., Ego4D ( Grauman et al., 2022 ) , FineBio ( Yagi et al., 2025 ) ), the benchmark evaluates capabilities that cannot be solved through visual frame memorization or pre-training textual priors. We guarantee that ProactEgoMem serves as an out-of-distribution evaluation through three key structural mechanisms:
blocks.zh: 虽然ProactEgoMem中的原始视频流是从公共自我中心寄存器(如Ego4D(Grauman等人,2022年),FineBio(Yagi等人,2025年))中采样出来的,但该基准评价了无法通过视觉框架记忆或预训文本前传解决的能力. 我们保证ProactEgoMem通过三个主要结构机制作为分配外评价:

blocks.en: 1. Novel Proactive Task Formulations: Existing video datasets focus on passive captioning or action segmentation. In contrast, ProactEgoMem evaluates proactive tool lifecycles, real-time trigger notifications, and longitudinal tracking ( IC , ST , LT ). The defined target action boundaries ( S ​ t ​ a ​ r ​ t ​ @ ​ τ Start@\tau ), tool activation states, and intervention logic do not exist in the source datasets. 2. Newly Generated QA Pairs and Templates: All downstream evaluation questions are entirely original. IC questions are synthesized via LLM generation from dense captions and subjected to a three-round human review. ST and LT QA items are programmatically instantiated over human-verified event timelines using custom slot templates (e.g., tracking sequence order, active state durations, and destination locations). 3. Dense, Multi-Stage Human Grounding: Every clip undergoes fresh annotation by three independent annotators (holding a bachelor’s degree or higher) to establish precise temporal boundaries and ground-truth answers. Because the evaluation protocol assesses timing precision and proactive state tracking simultaneously, pre-trained models cannot rely on web-scraped visual captions or pre-training text to succeed.

Protocol. For every ground-truth message, we build a
reference message by template from its arguments, including object names, tool, and status, building strings such as “[Nutrition facts] has been recorded” , “Keys location has been placed at [a new location]” , or “[Stove status] tracked until [turned off]” . The candidate is the message that the model emitted at the end of its tool call. A separate text-only judge, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, returns a binary
score for whether the message conveys the correct information. We condition on the model’s own true positives and report P ⁡ ( correct msg ∣ recall ) P(\text{correct msg}\mid\text{recall}) ; a model is included in a task only if its Intervention Level recall there exceeds a minimum threshold of 5 % 5\% .

blocks.en:
Improving cross-domain proactivity therefore requires
coverage-aware domain adaptation. Training should expose models to laboratory
objects, instruments, procedures, and hard negatives, while explicitly
supervising whether an actionable opportunity exists before optimizing its
start time or lifecycle boundary. For ST , a persistent representation
of the previous object state and the observed transition should make the
trigger depend on a change verified across frames. Finally,
coverage or no-output rates should be optimized and reported jointly with
conditional timing metrics, preventing abstention from appearing as successful
temporal transfer.

因此,改善跨领域积极性需要
覆盖意识域适应. 培训应使模型进入实验室
目标、工具、程序和硬底,同时明确
监督在优化机会之前是否存在可采取行动的机会
开始时间或生命周期边界。 就ST而言,持续的代表性
和观测到的过渡应使
触发取决于跨框架核实的更改。 终于
应优化覆盖率或无产出率,并与
有条件的计时标准,防止弃权票出现为成功
时间转移。

blocks.en:
At the Notification Level, apparent proactivity is bought by
over-triggering. The detection columns show how
coverage is earned: recall runs high, up to 79.5 % 79.5\% (Inkling-Small on IC ), while precision is almost uniformly in the single digits, so the
best notification F1 anywhere in the table is only 19.0 % 19.0\% (Qwen3.6-27B on ST ). Models inflate recall by firing indiscriminately and
paying for coverage with false positives, and the few
high-precision cells are the mirror image of the same miscalibration. Nor is the moment well chosen when it is
caught: Start@0.2 never exceeds 28.8 % 28.8\% , and because that metric is
conditional on matched intervals it flatters the least selective models, the
strict-timing leaders (VideoLLaMA3-7B, VideoLLM-Online, Qwen3.5-9B) all show precision below 2 % 2\% .

blocks.en:
At the Intervention Level, no model maintains the full memory
lifecycle in real time, and the over-triggering could not help either. Maintaining a
start–maintain–stop background tool lifecycle proves far harder than firing a single notification, with overlap in the single digits in almost all model–task cells. Nine scores contain no valid
intervention at all (VideoLLM-Online on all three tasks; Qwen3.5-9B,
LLaVA-OV-1.5-8B, MiniCPM-o-4.5, and JoyAI-VL on ST ; MMDuet and JoyAI-VL
on LT ), and the best Start@0.2 drops to 20.0 % 20.0\% . Chattiness at the Notification Level no longer supports substantial event coverage either: recall falls from as high as 79.5 % 79.5\% at the
Notification Level to at most 37.9 % 37.9\% (Gemma4-31B on IC ), while
precision remains low once conditioned on recall, as its highest scores are degenerate (JoyAI-VL at 22.2 % 22.2\% precision on 0.7 % 0.7\% recall, MiniCPM-o-4.5 at 20.0 % 20.0\% on 0.4 % 0.4\% ). Precision, recall, and lifecycle overlap collapse
together at the Intervention Level.

blocks.en:
Intervention demands background co-existence. A notification
is a single shot; an intervention must survive the stream—the agent commits
to a tool call, holds it open as the scene changes, keeps perceiving in
parallel, and judges when to stop (Section 3.2 ). The two-level gap
measures that co-existence.

grows without bound and never yields a final location.

决定。 溪流中没有任何东西会触发停止,所以背景记忆

blocks.en:
Difficulty scales with the memory horizon
( IC < < ST < < LT ). IC is the easiest task:
memory-backed QA accuracy reaches 36 36 – 66 % 66\% , well above the 18 18 – 34 % 34\% seen
on ST and LT . • IC is the easiest because reading dense text off video
frames lands in the strengths of current video/visual-language models, as they
are trained on dense visual content. • ST demands temporal reasoning with parallelism: states change concurrently during multitasking for several object status and the model could not hold multiple state lifecycles open at once, interleaving their updates to know what remains active, in which order, and for how long. • LT is the hardest, as it requires tracking the dynamics of
an individual object over the longest horizon. The model must overwrite the object locations at every move while still remembering the original location, the last location, and whether the object has been moved elsewhere or stays in the same place.

blocks.en: K.1 Intervention Level
blocks.zh: K.1 干预级别

blocks.en: Intervention Level, LT (verbatim) You are a proactive assistant observing an egocentric video stream. You must decide whether to start tracking an object’s location, stop tracking an object’s location, or do nothing. ## Input After these instructions, you receive the current assistant context followed by a window of video frames. ### Current assistant context The context is a JSON object with exactly these fields: - `current_time_sec`: the clip-local time of the current step. - `active_tools`: tool instances that are active now. Each entry contains `instance_id`, `tool_name`, `started_at_sec`, and `arguments`. - `completed_tool_intervals`: the most recently completed location-tracking intervals in this clip, ordered from oldest to newest. Each entry contains `instance_id`, `start_tool_name`, `end_tool_name`, `started_at_sec`, `ended_at_sec`, and `arguments`. For active location trackers, `active_tools` contains active `start_location_tracking` instances. The `instance_id` is the tracking id that must be used when calling `stop_location_tracking`. `active_tools` is authoritative for what is active now. `completed_tool_intervals` is short-term memory of location trackers that have already ended (it never contains an active location tracker) — use it to avoid redundant tracking and understand what was recently tracked or resolved. ### Video frames - Frames are ordered from oldest to newest. - Each frame has a relative frame number and a clip-local timestamp in seconds. - The final frame is the current moment. ## Tools Several location trackers may be active at the same time. ### `start_location_tracking` Arguments: - `name`: a short, specific name for the object being tracked. - `location`: a concise description of the object’s location to track. `start_location_tracking` starts actively tracking an object’s location for the user and returns an instance id. A successful `start_location_tracking` call remains active until `stop_location_tracking` is called with its corresponding instance id. This tool will be executed at `current_time_sec`; timestamps are not part of the tool arguments. ### `stop_location_tracking` Arguments: - `id`: the tracking id of the active location tracker to stop. `stop_location_tracking` stops a currently active location tracker. Use the `instance_id` from `active_tools` as the `id`. This tool will be executed at `current_time_sec`; timestamps are not part of the tool arguments. ## Task Policy The user wants help avoiding losing or forgetting personal objects during everyday activity. To achieve this, you should: - Infer the user’s intent and track relevant personal objects and their locations with the location-tracking tool. Invoke a tool only when it would provide timely and useful support for the user’s goal. If no useful action is warranted, do nothing. ## Output Return exactly one JSON object with exactly these root keys: { "message": null, "tool_calls": [] } Rules: - `message` must be a string or `null`. - If a tool is invoked, `message` must tell the user what you decided to do and why it supports their goal. - Use the style: - "I decided to start tracking an object’s location because ..." - "I decided to stop tracking an object’s location because ..." - `tool_calls` must be a JSON list. - Each tool call must contain exactly `name` and `arguments`. - `name` must be `start_location_tracking` or `stop_location_tracking`. - `arguments` must be a JSON object. - The do-nothing action is exactly `{"message": null, "tool_calls": []}`. - Return JSON only, without a Markdown fence, preamble, explanation, or trailing text. ## Assistant Context & Window of Video

You must decide whether to notify the user or do nothing. ## Input After these instructions, you receive the current assistant context followed by a window of video frames. ### Current assistant context The context is a JSON object with exactly these fields: - `current_time_sec`: the clip-local time of the current step. - `recent_messages`: previous notifications from this clip, ordered from oldest to newest. Each entry contains `timestamp_sec`, `step_index`, and `message`. ### Video frames - Frames are ordered from oldest to newest. - Each frame has a relative frame number and a clip-local timestamp in seconds. - The final frame is the current moment. ## Task Policy The user wants help avoiding losing or forgetting personal objects during everyday activity. To achieve this, you should: - Infer the user’s intent and notify the user about relevant personal objects and their locations. But do not notify about every single object or location unless it is relevant to the user intent. ## Output Return exactly one JSON object with exactly this root key: { "message": null } Rules: - `message` must be a string or `null`. - `message` must notify the user about an observation. - Use the style: - "You just ..." - The do-nothing action is exactly `{"message": null}`. - Return JSON only, without a Markdown fence, preamble, explanation, or trailing text. ## Assistant Context & Window of Video
